integrity: Standalone verifier reconstructs finite graph, connected-triple complex, signed boundary operators, unit-pivot integer reductions, and fundamental-group generators directly from the residue definition; proofs and limits stated explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact computation for the Paley graph on thirteen vertices; homotopy classification is for the combinatorial Alexander dual only, whereas the original cut complex has an integral homology classification. No infinite-family or equivariant statement, and no independent mathematical validation.
title: The ordinary three-cut complex of the Paley graph on thirteen vertices
